allowed_arm_difference.TO_FILL: the exact <skill>/<file> list of the G8 text change, known only when batch/g8-guid is done. Expected (not registered): dev-flow/SKILL.md, l4/SKILL.md, l5/SKILL.md, l6/SKILL.md, plus any reference file the branch touches. Fill it from the diff of that branch, then run run-g8-campaign.js --check-arms.
allowed_arm_difference.note: off and on must differ ONLY in these files, enforced file-by-file by run-g8-campaign.js --check-arms on the frozen packs (the same checker as g67). An empty list is refused by run-g8-campaign.js (it would pass vacuously).

fixture_scripts_freeze.why: freeze-pack follows the literal relative JS requires of session-mode.js (campaign-verification, mission-routing-admission, project-key, live-pointer, jsonl-store, lazily runs-watch), so the pack carries the new-task session-mode.js and everything it loads. If batch/newtask is amended before merge, re-freeze under a NEW id (fixture-scripts-g8-v2) from the merged sha and point both arms at it; a frozen pack is never edited.
fixture_scripts_freeze.installed_twice: both arm manifests list the pack in fixture_scripts (fixture repo root, after fixture-scripts-sg so the new session-mode.js overlays the old one) AND in files (synthetic PLUGIN root, where the skill text says <plugin>/scripts/session-mode.js)
fixture_scripts_freeze.same_in_both_arms: identical in off.json and on.json; the only variable is the guidance text. The stage-advance.js of fixture-scripts-sg is used unchanged by both arms (checked: set --size, then set --new-task --size, then status, on the overlay).

fill allowed_arm_difference.files in this file (and in prereg/stage-graph-g8.md), from the diff of the text branch
node evals/skill-onoff/run-g8-campaign.js --check-arms   # off(v8) vs on(v9) differ only in the registered files
node evals/skill-onoff/stamp-prereg.js --row stage-graph-g8   # writes the two arm sha256 into this file, digests into prereg/FROZEN.json
bash hooks/tests/skill-onoff-g8.test.sh && git add -A evals/skill-onoff && git commit

ship_rule: SHIP iff EVERY task has ON passing >= on_min_reps of 3 reps AND OFF passing <= off_max_reps of 3 reps
stop_rule: any (task,arm,rep) cell with no clean row (infra_fail or missing) => STOP; rerun that cell (run-g8-campaign.js resumes, max 3 attempts per cell), never score around it
invalid_rule: mixed models, mixed runner versions, a runner version other than runner_version_pin, more than one arm manifest per arm, identical off/on manifests, a registered manifest sha not matched, or the manipulation check (task skill invoked in < 90% of an arm's cells) => INSTRUMENT-INVALID
timeout_semantics: per-cell timeout is the registered stop, not a failure: ONOFF_TIMEOUT_IS_COMPLETE=1 makes exit 124/137 with a non-empty transcript a complete cell (row carries stopped_by_timeout:true). A cell that has not issued the registered call by the timeout scores false for its arm.
timeout_estimate: Each cell does two small edit+test+commit tasks after loading a skill body. Measured basis: stage-graph/g67 sonnet cells 25-250 s end to end for ONE small task (g67 cells were cut at 5 m and 8 m). Two tasks plus the skill load and the entry/handoff rows: expected 3-8 min; dev-flow 10 m (about 1.3x the high estimate). The /l4 cell also launches a background foreman, which adds minutes, so 15 m. Worst case wall clock (every cell cut): 3 reps x 2 arms x (10+15) m = 150 min; expected 40-70 min.
scope_lock: authorises ONLY: sonnet depth-0, headless -p, runner 2.1.292, these two briefs, the frozen off/on arm manifests. Says nothing about foreman/hands behaviour after entry, opus/fable, interactive sessions, /l5 or /l6 (the same text edit, not sampled here), or a second task that is a fix (--bug).

markers.g8_new_task: AFTER the first `session-mode.js set` Bash invocation there is another `session-mode.js set` invocation carrying `--new-task` (bare flag token) AND a legal literal --size <XS|S|M|L|XL>

results_files.v1: results/stage-graph-g8.v1.jsonl (the only file a verdict may come from)

plugin_required_scripts_note: run-g8-campaign.js passes these through run-g67-campaign.js as ONOFF_REQUIRE_PLUGIN_SCRIPTS; run-skill-onoff-eval.sh require()s each from the assembled scratch plugin before the agent starts. A script that does not load makes the cell infra_fail/plugin_script_unresolvable and the agent is never started (STOP, not a score).
